REPLACE:nd_adu_dest_golden_age = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_adu_dest_translators
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = ADU has_variable = nd_adu_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		owns = location:palermo
		# Twenty-seven schools, as many as al-Hakam II opened in Cordoba. The
		# building is the country's own, of age 2. The stage asked for the
		# scientific revolution (age 5) while the other path has no age floor.
		any_owned_location = {
			count >= 27
			has_building = building_type:nd_adu_madrasa
		}
		prestige >= 75
		gold >= 3000
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_adu_dest_cordoba_developed_tt
			location:cordoba = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 64
			}
		}
	}
	icon = enlightened_court
	unlock_building = nd_adu_bayt_al_hikma
	global_integration_speed_modifier = 0.15
	spy_network_construction = 0.15
	global_devastation_recovery = 0.00425
}

	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_aeg_destiny
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = AEG has_variable = nd_aeg_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_aeg_path_b_tt
			has_variable = nd_aeg_path_b
		}
		has_embraced_institution = institution:printing_press
		# Cairo grown a quarter above its 1337 value of 32. (This line asked
		# for all of Alexandria province, which the Mamluks hold on day one
		# and which lists a lake nobody can own.)
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_aeg_dest_cairo_developed_tt

				owner ?= root
				development >= 40
			}
		}
		gold >= 1000
	}

}

REPLACE:nd_ahm_dest_bengal_core = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_ahm_dest_bengal_frontier
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = AHM has_variable = nd_ahm_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:gaur
		owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:sonargaon
		# The Ahom army is the paik levy, so no head count of a standing army
		# (planner Step 4). The Ahoms took up the matchlock from the Bengal
		# army they beat in 1532 to 1533, and held Bengal's guns off with it.
		has_embraced_institution = institution:pike_and_shot
	}
	icon = feudalism_advance

REPLACE:nd_ahm_dest_satra_outreach = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_ahm_destiny
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = AHM has_variable = nd_ahm_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_ahm_path_b_tt
			has_variable = nd_ahm_path_b
		}
		has_embraced_institution = institution:renaissance
		capital = {
			market = {
				OR = {
					is_produced_in_market = goods:silk
					is_traded_in_market = goods:silk
				}
			}
		}
		# Bordowa (Batadrava), Sankardev's birthplace and the site of his
		# first prayer hall: the mother house the network grows out from.
		# 1337 value 16.5 (development_estimate.py --explain bordowa), stage 1 = +25%.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_ahm_dest_bordowa_developed_tt
			location:bordowa = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 21
			}
		}
	}
	icon = organized_religion
	# Religious influence belongs to the Christian family plus mayan and
	# hellenism, so it paid Ahom nothing. The advance already asks for the
	# Renaissance and a silk market: let the satra network carry onward what
	# the trade routes carried in.
	global_institution_growth_modifier = 0.1
	global_devastation_recovery = 0.00425
}

	# Munich is the place this stage is about: under Max I Joseph and Ludwig I
	# it went from about 40,000 people in 1800 to about 100,000 by 1850, with
	# the Maxvorstadt, the Ludwigstrasse and the Koenigsplatz laid out new.
	# Its 1337 value is 27 (scripts/development_estimate.py --explain munich);
	# stage three asks for twice that.

		gold >= 3000

			text = nd_bav_dest_munich_developed_tt

				owner ?= root

		}

	# architects, painters and sculptors at work for a generation.
	num_possible_artists = 1
	global_population_growth = 0.00148

REPLACE:nd_gre_dest_light = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_gre_dest_maritime
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = GRE has_variable = nd_gre_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		# The Greek Enlightenment was a work of the press: Greek books were printed
		# at Venice from 1499 and Korais's Hellenic Library carried the classics
		# home. The stage asks for the printing press (age 3), so that both paths
		# can be finished in a similar span (owner's ruling 2026-10-02).
		has_embraced_institution = institution:printing_press
		gold >= 3000
		prestige >= 75
		# Athens was a small town in 1830 and a capital with a university by 1837.
		# 29 in 1337 (development_estimate.py --explain athens), doubled.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_gre_dest_athens_developed_tt
			location:athens = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 58
			}
		}
	}
	icon = global_trade_advance
	unlock_building = nd_gre_hellenic_lyceum
	global_monthly_development = 0.0031
	global_population_growth = 0.00148
	cultural_influence_modifier = 0.1
}

	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_gre_dest_republic
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = GRE has_variable = nd_gre_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		capital = {
			market = {
				OR = {
					is_produced_in_market = goods:silk
					is_traded_in_market = goods:silk
				}
			}
		}
		# Chios was the house of the Greek merchant families (Ralli, Rodocanachi,
		# Argenti) and wove silk of its own until 1822. 15.2 in 1337
		# (development_estimate.py --explain chios), half as much again.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_gre_dest_chios_developed_tt
			location:chios = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 23
			}
		}

	}

	global_trade_center_power = 0.1

REPLACE:nd_hab_dest_burgundia = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_hab_dest_corona
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = HAB has_variable = nd_hab_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	# Antwerp is the Habsburg Netherlands' own boom: about 40,000 people when
	# Philip the Fair inherited, about 100,000 under Charles V, the staple of
	# Portuguese spice and English cloth. Its 1337 value is 32.8
	# (scripts/development_estimate.py --explain antwerp); stage two asks
	# for half as much again. Ghent, where Charles V was born in 1500, stands
	# for the cities of Flanders the stage's text names.
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_hab_dest_antwerp_developed_tt
			location:antwerp = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 49
			}
		}
		owns = location:ghent
		gold >= 2000
	}
	icon = merchants_and_trade
	trade_land_efficiency = 0.1

	trade_sea_efficiency = 0.1

	global_monthly_prosperity = 0.0017
}

		# Dutch factor van Wuysthoff found it the kingdom's market in 1641.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_lxa_dest_vientiane_developed_tt
			location:vientiane = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 29
			}
		}
		prestige >= 50
		gold >= 2000
	}
	icon = merchants_and_trade
	tax_income_efficiency = 0.044
	global_build_buildings_efficiency = 0.1
}

REPLACE:nd_plc_dest_breadbasket = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_plc_dest_sejm_ascendant
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = PLC has_variable = nd_plc_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		# Gdansk is the port the grain went out through. It grew from a
		# Teutonic harbour into the Commonwealth's largest city on that
		# trade. 1337 value 25.8 (scripts/development_estimate.py
		# --explain gdansk), raised by half for a second stage.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_plc_dest_gdansk_developed_tt
			location:gdansk = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 39
			}
		}
		gold >= 2000
		capital = {
			market = {
				OR = {
					is_produced_in_market = goods:wheat
					is_traded_in_market = goods:wheat
				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = agriculture_advance
	global_trade_center_power = 0.05
	global_monthly_development = 0.0024
}

REPLACE:nd_plc_dest_sejm_ascendant = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_plc_destiny
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = PLC has_variable = nd_plc_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_plc_path_a_tt
			has_variable = nd_plc_path_a
		}
		owns = location:gdansk
		has_embraced_institution = institution:banking
		gold >= 1000
	}
	icon = merchants_and_trade
	tax_income_efficiency = 0.044
	# The stage asks for banking and a full treasury: the republic's credit
	# grows (5 a month is what vanilla gives its banking cultures, the
	# Tuscans, Ligurians and Catalans). Not prosperity, which Poland's
	# vanilla land_of_promise grants in the same age.
	monthly_loan_capacity_investment = 5
}

	requires = nd_pom_dest_counting_houses
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = POM has_variable = nd_pom_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	# The Hanse ruled the Baltic in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries,
	# long before the institution of global trade (age 4) this stage used to
	# ask for. Its hold was the Scanian herring coast: the Peace of
	# Stralsund (1370) gave the towns the castles of the Sound, Skanoer and
	# Falsterbo among them, which lie in the location malmo.

		owns = location:visby
		owns = location:malmo

REPLACE:nd_rum_dest_crossroads = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_rum_dest_emporium
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = TUR has_variable = nd_rum_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		# The learning of Seljuk Anatolia stood in its medreses and its
		# hospitals (the Gevher Nesibe of Kayseri taught medicine from 1206),
		# so the stage asks for them and not for an institution of the fifth
		# age: both paths can end in a similar span.
		any_owned_location = {
			count >= 5
			has_building = building_type:nd_rum_medrese
		}
		any_owned_location = {
			count >= 2
			has_building = building_type:nd_rum_darussifa
		}
		gold >= 3000
		# Konya, the Seljuk capital and the city of Mevlana. 23 in 1337,
		# doubled.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_rum_dest_konya_developed_tt
			location:konya = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 46
			}
		}
		prestige >= 75
	}
	icon = global_trade_advance
	unlock_building = nd_rum_house_of_wisdom
	global_population_growth = 0.00148
	improve_relation_impact = 0.15
	cultural_influence_modifier = 0.1
}

		# with nd_sar_piedmont_statuta_sabaudiae (age 2). The Enlightenment
		# stood here and kept this path three ages behind the other.

			count >= 4

		}
		# Cagliari, seat of the island's own bench: the Reale Udienza sat
		# there, and the university was refounded there in 1764. 23 in 1337
		# (development_estimate.py --explain cagliari), doubled for a capstone.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_sar_piedmont_dest_cagliari_developed_tt

				owner ?= root
				development >= 46
			}
		}
	}
	icon = vid_the_codex_shishman
	unlock_building = nd_sar_piedmont_archivio
	research_speed_modifier = 0.05
	government_size = 1
	global_estate_target_satisfaction = 0.0425

REPLACE:nd_tib_dest_tsenpo_restored = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_tib_destiny
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = TIB has_variable = nd_tib_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_tib_path_b_tt
			has_variable = nd_tib_path_b
		}
		# Yarlung, not Lhasa: Lhasa anchors the Ganden Phodrang branch, and
		# a location shared by both makes the branch choice partly free.
		# The tsenpo line came out of the Yarlung valley, so the imperial
		# restoration starts where the dynasty did: Nedong, the seat in
		# the Yarlung valley. The main former holds Nedong on day one, so
		# the stage asks for the seat to be built: a town or larger
		# (vanilla's own shape, advances/country_yem.txt, port_of_aden).
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_tib_dest_nedong_town_tt
			location:nedong = {
				owner ?= root
				OR = {
					location_rank ?= location_rank:town
					location_rank ?= location_rank:city
					location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
				}
			}
		}
		owns = location:dartsedo
		# Tibet starts as a vassal of the Yuan (12_diplomacy.txt). A tsenpo
		# has no overlord. No army_size here: the plateau's army is a levy.
		is_subject = no
	}
	icon = horse_riding_advance
	land_morale_recovery = 0.082
	regiment_recruit_speed = 0.1
}

REPLACE:nd_ukr_dest_breadbasket_empire = {
	age = age_1_traditions
	requires = nd_ukr_dest_black_earth_wealth
	potential = { has_or_had_tag = UKR has_variable = nd_ukr_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
	allow = {
		# The harvest that fills the port is grown on the great estates of
		# the black earth (the building of nd_ukr_black_earth). This stands
		# where the institution global_trade stood: that one waits for the
		# fourth age, while the other path can be finished in the first
		# (owner's ruling 2026-10-02, scripts/destiny/stage_floors.py).
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_ukr_dest_estates_tt
			any_owned_location = {
				count >= 10
				has_building = building_type:nd_ukr_chernozem_estate
			}
		}
		gold >= 3000
		# Odesa rose on the site of Khadjibey from a small fort to the grain
		# port of a continent. 5.5 in 1337, doubled, and grown to a city.
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nd_ukr_dest_khadjibey_developed_tt
			location:khadjibey = {
				owner ?= root
				development >= 11
				OR = {
					location_rank ?= location_rank:city
					location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
				}
			}
		}
		prestige >= 75
	}
	icon = global_trade_advance
	unlock_building = nd_ukr_grain_exchange
	global_trade_center_power = 0.1
	global_construction_speed = 0.1
	global_monthly_prosperity = 0.0017
}
